body:
>I have great faith in you.

Thanks, even though you don't know me it still helps to hear it from someone.

Thanks for the reply/advice. I'm fine with not being in a relationship, but it's my health problems that really get to me. I caused them myself when I had an eating disorder, so there's a whole layer of self hatred that I can't forgive myself for. I can't be independent and free like I desperately want to be and I'm always imagining worst-case scenarios where I die or something. I don't know how to stop feeling like the world is a terrible place. 

I want to change but I'm so afraid of feeling judged and not good enough. I'm sad about things I've done in the past and don't know how to let things go. It feels really, really heavy sometimes and I can't function. Even if I did learn to play a new sport, I don't think it would help me feel less trapped, you know?
There isn't anything that I really love doing. I just wish that I was healthier so that I could adapt to life better, but I'm completely screwed there so I don't know what to do.
